SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, O.SAMPLENUM, O.ORDERDESC, O.REMARK, O.SAMPLEID, O.SAMPLEBEGINDATE, O.SAMPLEBEGINTIME, O.SAMPLECOMPLETEDATE, O.SAMPLECOMPLETETIME, O.LABELNO, M.STATUS AS ORDERTASKSTATUS, M.MONITORTMPLID, M.ORDERCATEGORY, M.ANALYSISDATE, M.TESTNAME, M.METHODNAME, M.TESTMETHODBASIS, M.INDEXID, M.CUPNO, M.EQUIPTACQUNO, N.INDEXNAME, F.PLANSAMPLEDATE, F.FOLDERNO, F.MONITORPOINTID, F.MONITORPOINTNO, F.MONITORPOINTNAME, F.SAMPLEUSERNAME, P.TESTORGNAME, P.ENTRUSTORGNAME, P.PROJNO, P.PROJNAME, P.BIZCATEGORYCODE, P.REGISTDATE, R.ANALYSISUSERNAME, R.CHECKUSERNAME, R.ANALYSISBEGINDATE, E.EQUIPTNAME, E.EQUIPTID AS EQUIPTNO, C.SETNAME FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK_RESULT A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER O ON O.ID = A.ORDERID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK M ON M.ID = A.ORDERTASKID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_INDEX N ON N.ID = M.INDEXID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_FOLDER F ON F.ID = A.FOLDERID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT P ON P.ID = A.PROJID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_RUN R ON R.ID = A.RUNID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_EQUIPT E ON E.ID = R.EQUIPTID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ITEM B ON B.ID = A.ITEMID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_STANDARD_SET C ON C.ID = B.STANDSETID) T
AND T.REPORTRESULT IS NULL
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O, T_EMC_SUBCONTRACT_RECORD S WHERE O.ID = S.ORDERTASKID AND O.ID = T.ORDERTASKID AND O.FOLDERID = #{targetFolderId} AND O.STATUS = 'done' AND O.SUBCONTRACTORID IS NOT NULL)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O WHERE O.ID = T.ORDERTASKID AND O.FOLDERID = #{targetFolderId} AND O.STATUS = 'done' AND O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND O.DATASHARING = '1')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O WHERE O.ID = T.ORDERTASKID AND O.SUBCONTRACTORID IS NULL)
ORDER BY
T.ORDERNO, T.TESTNAME, T.ITEMORDERNO, T.REPEATNO

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT DISTINCT A.ID, A.ORDERTASKID, A.ITEMID, A.ITEMALIASNAME, A.UNITNAME, A.INDEXLOWLIMIT, A.INDEXHIGHLIMIT, A.ORDERNO, A.ORDERID, M.TESTNAME, M.INDEXID, N.INDEXNAME FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK_RESULT A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK M ON M.ID = A.ORDERTASKID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_INDEX N ON N.ID = M.INDEXID) T
ORDER BY
T.ORDERNO, T.TESTNAME

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT OT.*, S.SCRIPT1, S.SCRIPT2, S.VALIDATESCRIPT, S.SETNAME, ITS.SETNAME ITEMSETNAME FROM (SELECT OTR.*, CASE OTR.QCCATEGORYCODE WHEN 'N/A' THEN I.STANDSETID ELSE QC.QCGROUP END STANDSETID, I.STANDSETID ITEMSTANDSETID, I.LIMITREVISION, CASE OTR.SCRIPTFLAG WHEN '1' THEN I.SCRIPT ELSE NULL END TESTSCRIPT, I.CALQCRESULT, I.INTERCEPTREVISION, I.SLOPEREVISION, I.LIMITFLAG, I.NEGATIVETOZERO, I.SCIENTIFICNOTATION, I.AVGCALCTYPE, OT.STOCKBATCHNO, OT.TESTNAME, OT.METHODNAME, OT.PARENTID AS TASKPARENTID, TM.RECOVERYRATE FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK_RESULT OTR INNER JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT ON OTR.ORDERTASKID = OT.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ITEM I ON OTR.ITEMID = I.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_QC_CATEGORY QC ON OTR.QCCATEGORYID = QC.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_METHOD TM ON I.TESTMETHODID = TM.ID) OT LEFT JOIN T_EMC_STANDARD_SET S ON OT.STANDSETID = S.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_STANDARD_SET ITS ON OT.ITEMSTANDSETID = ITS.ID) T
ORDER BY
T.ORDERID, T.TESTID, T.ITEMORDERNO

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT C.RELATENAME, T.PROJID, T.MONITORTMPLID, R.ORDERNO, R.TESTID, T.TESTNAME, R.METHODID, T.METHODNAME, R.ITEMID, R.ITEMALIASNAME, R.REPORTRESULT FROM T_EMC_DATA_CORRELATION C, T_EMC_DATA_CORRELATION_ITEM I, T_EMC_ORDER_TASK T, T_EMC_ORDER_TASK_RESULT R WHERE C.ACTIVATEDFLAG = '1' AND R.CORRELATIONVALIDATEFLAG = '0' AND C.ID = I.CORRELATIONID AND I.ITEMID = R.ITEMID AND T.ID = R.ORDERTASKID) T
ORDER BY
T.RELATENAME, T.ORDERNO, T.TESTNAME, T.METHODNAME, T.ITEMALIASNAME
